conbody.p: Emergency braking will alert the driver with the Forward Safety warning light () blinking, a warning message, an audible warning and steering wheel vibration.
The brake assist will be activated to help avoid a collision with a vehicle, pedestrian, cyclist and powered two-wheeler.

li.p: *: If Forward Collision-Avoidance Assist determines that a collision cannot be avoided even by changing lanes due to the surrounding conditions of the vehicle, braking assistance is provided earlier. When the target object is stationary, Forward Collision-Avoidance Assist may operate at speeds between about 10-100 km/h (6-62 mph) (if equipped).
The pedestrian or cyclist speed is approximately 10-65 km/h (6-40 mph).
The target enters the operating area of the function.
The function operation range may decrease due to the front traffic condition or the surroundings of the vehicle.
When driving at night, the performance of powered two-wheeler recognition is decreased, so the Forward Collision-Avoidance Assist system may be temporarily limited or may not work.
